quotes.text: I tried, but I never get anyone in the chan! I don't know how/where to advertise... maybe we should set up a meeting time or something?

quotes.text: If you don't have your password set within a week I'll remove you from the userlist and I'll add you again next time I see you in the chan and make sure you set a pass.
